The latest lot-1 figure comes from 22759753, an F20 modification of the same contract 1-65030/2022: a 19% unit-price rise with VAL_TOTAL_BEFORE and VAL_TOTAL_AFTER both HUF 119,723,350. Lot 1 is therefore counted once, not doubled. S = 119,723,350 + 85,300,000 = 205,023,350 matches the stated total exactly. Each lot is its own one-supplier framework sum (keretosszeg), not a ceiling shared across lots, so the figures add. Today the API serves only lot 1 (HUF 119,723,350).

b.why: S = HUF 205,023,350 = LOT-1 119,723,350 (latest notice, F20 22759753) + LOT-2 85,300,000 (F03 22480086). The F03 22480086 states a notice-level VAL_TOTAL of 205,023,350, which equals S exactly. 22759753 is a contract modification for LOT-1 only, raising unit prices by 19%, with VAL_TOTAL_BEFORE = VAL_TOTAL_AFTER = 119,723,350. S takes LOT-1 once, from the latest notice, and does not also add the 22480086 RES-1, so the restatement is not double counted. The lot figures are framework amounts (keretösszeg), each lot with a single supplier (E-Group for lot 1, PoliCell for lot 2), so the figures are not a shared ceiling and add up. The F14 22238016 had already corrected LOT-1 from 151,181,590 to 119,723,350, so no stale figure is in S. LOT-3 is discontinued (clos-nw) and not summed. Today's figure, 119,723,350 (lot 1 only), is farther from the stated total.

These are distinct lots with distinct suppliers and contracts, and they sum to BT-118-NoticeResult 520,000 exactly. The earlier versions 24672402 and 24668425 are contract notices with no money figures to contradict this. Today the API serves null, so S matches the stated total and is strictly better.

a.why: F21 award notice 19614525 (joint procurement by VOLÁNBUSZ and the Közlekedési Központok, security services). Lots 1, 2, 3, 4 and 6 were discontinued. Lot 5 (KMKK) VAL_TOTAL is HUF 994,843,595 (contract no. 1) and lot 7 (VOLÁNBUSZ) is HUF 2,485,222,874 (contract no. 2). Both went to the same ELIT/CIVIL/MPT consortium, but the lots serve different buyers under different contracts. The procedure VAL_TOTAL is HUF 3,480,066,469, which equals S exactly. The later F20 notice 20518107 modifies only lot 7 (successor company after a corporate change), with VAL_TOTAL_BEFORE = AFTER = 2,485,222,874, so it changes nothing. Today the API serves 2,485,222,874 (lot 7 only), which is farther from the stated total.

b.why: F21 award notice 19614525 (Hungarian security services, 7 lots). Lots 1-4 and 6 were declared unsuccessful (clos-nw, INFO_ADD '1., 2., 3., 4., 6.rész eredménytelen'), and S correctly leaves them out. The summed lots are lot 5, 994,843,595 HUF, and lot 7, 2,485,222,874 HUF. They add to 3,480,066,469 HUF, which equals the notice's TED-VALUE and VAL_TOTAL (PROCUREMENT_TOTAL). I checked for a restated lot: F20 modification 20518107 (2019, lot 7) has VAL_TOTAL_BEFORE = AFTER = 2,485,222,874, with no price change. The API keys it as RES-1 with no lot, and S does not add it again; doing so would have given about 5.97bn. Today's figure, lot 7 alone, is farther from the stated total.

The F20 lot-null results simply repeat lot 1's 3,143,763.05 and are not added into S. b.why: F06 award notice 20261370 (DB Netz, 2 lots, both to Ed. Züblin under one contract number 18FEI34032). Lot 1 is 3,143,763.05 EUR and lot 2 is 721,110.63 EUR; S = 3,864,873.68 equals the notice's VALUE and VAL_TOTAL (PROCUREMENT_TOTAL). The 12 F20 modifications from 2020 (21348580 to 21363205) confirm that both lots belong to one contract worth the sum: the first ones carry VAL_TOTAL_BEFORE 3,864,873.67 and DESCRIPTION_PROCUREMENT.VAL_TOTAL 3,864,873.68. That chain later raises the contract to as much as 5,124,923.33 (21362092). The API keys each modification's echoed lot-1 3,143,763.05 as RES-1 with no lot, and S does not sum those. Today's 3,143,763.05 (lot 1 only) is farther from the award total and from the modified total. Caveat: after modification the contract is worth more than S, but that is outside what this lot-sum rule decides.

a.why: F15 VEAT notice 23384695 (AFNOR, 2 lots, both won by VIDEAS). RES-1 VAL_TOTAL is EUR 25,000 (lot 1, storage) and RES-2 VAL_TOTAL is EUR 57,000 (lot 2, CDN), so these are distinct real awards of distinct lots. The procedure-level PROCUREMENT_TOTAL range is LOW EUR 82,000 / HIGH EUR 217,000. S = 82,000 equals the stated LOW exactly. INFO_ADD says 'Le prestataire a fait une offre globale pour les 2 lots', which supports adding the two lots. Today the API serves 57,000 (lot 2 only), which is farther from both stated figures. The HIGH of 217,000 is probably a 4-year ceiling ('calculé sur la base de 4 ans maximum'; the justification cites a contract below 215k). Even against that, S is closer than today's 57k.

b.why: F15 VEAT notice 23384695 (AFNOR, OJS 2023/S 150-478983). Lot 1 VAL_TOTAL 25,000 EUR and lot 2 VAL_TOTAL 57,000 EUR are two distinct lots, both won by VIDEAS. INFO_ADD says 'Le prestataire a fait une offre globale pour les 2 lots', so the two figures are one global offer split by lot, not parallel offers. S = 82,000 equals the procedure-level TED-LOW 82,000 (VALUE_RANGE.TYPE PROCUREMENT_TOTAL). TED-HIGH 217,000 is the highest offer taken into consideration, not the award: D_JUSTIFICATION says the whole contract is below 215k EUR, which 217k would break. There is a single version and no modification. Today's figure, 57,000 (lot 2 alone), is farther from the stated total. No double count, slip or ceiling found.
